events.title: Connecting to Place II: Blue Ridge Craft Trails Invitational
events.description: Connecting to Place II: Blue Ridge Craft Trails Invitational 2026 will be on view at Mars Landing Arts Center in Mars Hill, NC. The exhibition features works by artists from the Blue Ridge Craft Trails. Curator M. Anna Fariello created the exhibition with the vision of tying today’s living traditions back to the region’s history and nature. Participants are from the Far West region of Western North Carolina, representing seven towns and the Qualla Boundary: Franklin, Waynesville, Dillsboro, Bryson City, Cullowhee, Canton, Cherokee, Maggie Valley, and Brasstown. The artwork consists of different mediums including clay, fiber, metal, paper, and wood. Artists: Myron Carter, Susan Coe, Laurey Faye Dean, Brad Dodson, Gayle R. Haynie, Karen H. Hovis, Carol Lynn Johnson, Ilene Kay, Joe Frank McKee, Mike McKinney, Paul Hornbuckle, Janlyn Messina, Davy Arch, Caden Painter, Terance Painter, Paul Pieringer, William S. Rogers, Desmond Suarez, Gayle Barker Woody

events.title: Trails Less Traveled: Charlies Bunion
events.description: Join us for this 8-Mile out and back hike with an elevation gain of 1,640 feet to one of the most scenic vistas in The Great Smokies. Leaving from the Newfound Gap parking lot, this hike follows a gorgeous stretch of the Appalachian Trail through the highest closed-forest zone of Red Spruce and Fraser Fir in the Smokies while offering outstanding views of the North Carolina Smokies to the south and the legendary Mt. LeConte and Myrtle Point culminating with the expansive views from Charlies Bunion. This hike is recommended for experienced hikers only.

Participants are from the Far West region of Western North Carolina, representing seven towns and the Qualla Boundary: Franklin, Waynesville, Dillsboro, Bryson City, Cullowhee, Canton, Cherokee, Maggie Valley, and Brasstown. The artwork consists of different mediums including clay, fiber, metal, paper, and wood. Artists: Myron Carter, Susan Coe, Laurey Faye Dean, Brad Dodson, Gayle R. Haynie, Karen H. Hovis, Carol Lynn Johnson, Ilene Kay, Joe Frank McKee, Mike McKinney, Paul Hornbuckle, Janlyn Messina, Davy Arch, Caden Painter, Terance Painter, Paul Pieringer, William S. Rogers, Desmond Suarez, Gayle Barker Woody
